question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Huge**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "**Huge**" means very large in size or amount. (विशाल)
 
• This word emphasizes the vastness and expansiveness of the sky.
 
• Describing the sky as "huge" conveys the idea that it is an immense expanse, akin to a sea, creating
